title: Working with Zenoh (rmw_zenoh)
text: rmw_zenoh_cpp uses Zenoh instead of DDS. Nodes discover each other through a Zenoh router (ros2 run rmw_zenoh_cpp rmw_zenohd) rather than multicast, which works well across networks and in containers. Every node must use rmw_zenoh_cpp: Zenoh nodes and DDS nodes never discover one another. If nothing is discovered, check that a router is running and reachable and that RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_zenoh_cpp is set in every shell.
